_comment: Paired P-only screen (bots/p_only/tools/run_screen.py). Every arm plays the same fixtures (map, flag seed, seat, opponents from the frozen reference roster) under the official limits; only our bot changes. aa arms replay an arm's identical binary to measure re-run noise. The C08 P-only size and the arms and comparisons below are set by bots/p_only/tools/size_rule.py --apply after the Phase 1 timing run (default until then: M). c08_control_2ply separates 'the network replaced the script' from 'the search got shallower'. Seed 20261031 is the tuning seed: never reuse 20261009 or 20261020, and keep the confirmation seed unseen until the finalists are frozen.
